description: Defines the GraphSignature class which models the input and output specifications of a computational graph exported via torch.export. It includes methods for accessing graph input/output mappings, weight and buffer information, and serialization support.

classes.name: GraphSignature
classes.description: Represents the input/output specifications of an exported computational graph, including mappings for parameters, buffers, constants, and user-defined inputs/outputs.

methods.name: GraphSignature
methods.description: Default constructor and constructor from serialized storage.

methods.name: lossOutput
methods.description: Returns the loss output specification.

methods.name: gradientsToParameters
methods.description: Returns mapping from gradient names to parameter names.

methods.name: gradientsToUserInputs
methods.description: Returns mapping from gradient names to user input names.

methods.name: inputsToParameters
methods.description: Returns a map of input names to parameter names.

methods.name: inputsToBuffers
methods.description: Returns a map of input names to buffer names.

methods.name: inputsToTensorConstants
methods.description: Returns a map of input names to tensor constant names.

methods.name: inputsToCustomObjs
methods.description: Returns custom object inputs.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns list of parameter names.

methods.name: buffers
methods.description: Returns list of buffer names.

methods.name: nonPersistentBuffers
methods.description: Returns list of non-persistent buffer names.

methods.name: tensorConstants
methods.description: Returns list of tensor constant names.

methods.name: customObjs
methods.description: Returns list of custom object names.

methods.name: userInputs
methods.description: Returns list of user input names.

methods.name: userOutputs
methods.description: Returns list of user output names.

methods.name: buffersToMutate
methods.description: Returns buffers that can be mutated.

methods.name: userInputsToMutate
methods.description: Returns user inputs that can be mutated.

methods.name: hasBackward
methods.description: Indicates if the graph has backward pass information.

methods.name: inputsToWeights
methods.description: Returns the mapping of input to weight names with stable order.

methods.name: lint
methods.description: Performs validation on the graph signature.

methods.name: replaceAllUses
methods.description: Replaces all uses of a symbol with another.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the GraphSignature to a schema.
